identity.name: Palm Beach Country Estates
identity.hoa_name: Palm Beach Country Estates Landowners Association (voluntary, NOT a POA or HOA)
identity.notes: A 2,000-acre large-lot residential community in Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33418, featuring approximately 1,500 custom single-family homes on minimum 1-acre wooded lots. The community has NO mandatory HOA or POA; instead, the voluntary Palm Beach Country Estates Landowners Association (founded 1980) provides community support, maintenance, and events without enforcement authority. Emphasizes equestrian-friendly, flexible rural-suburban living.

fees.note: Voluntary contribution to PBCE Landowners Association (NOT mandatory). Gives landowners a vote and voice; helps pay for community services. No mandatory HOA or POA fees exist. County zoning and building codes apply instead of HOA rules. (Confirmed by pbce.org official site and hoabulletinboard.com)

Voluntary minimum annual contribution to the Palm Beach Country Estates Landowners Association (founded 1980); grants voting rights and funds maintenance, events, and improvements. NOT a mandatory HOA/POA fee — there is no mandatory HOA in this community. Contributions above $50 can be directed to specific funds (e.g., sidewalk repairs). Source is an AI-generated encyclopedia; verify with the association (pbce.org, pbcegroup@gmail.com). Rejected 2006 referendum for $1,000/lot/yr road paving (20 yrs) was NOT adopted (58% voted no).

SIRWCD (South Indian River Water Control District) potable water system assessment: $780 per lot per year over 25 years, approved 2006 (63% of votes), water system built 2006-2007, total project cost $18.6M. 25-year term would run to ~2032; confirm current status with SIRWCD/county. Source is an AI-generated encyclopedia; verify before relying on it.

amenities.detail: Margaret Berman Memorial Park with playground, courts, trails, and disc golf (community-supported, not HOA-managed)
Bike trails and walking trails; nearby Riverbend Park access
Security cameras at entrance and intersections; entrance and intersection maintenance by voluntary association
Equestrian-friendly community; many properties feature private equestrian facilities
Annual community events and bi-monthly association meetings (second Tuesday); newsletter 'Countryside Living'
No clubhouse, no community pool, no golf course, no fitness center — traditional centralized HOA amenities are unavailable
No mandatory HOA — freedom to build, expand, or use space for boats, RVs, workshops, home-based businesses; private pools and guest houses on individual lots

Margaret Berman Memorial Park: playground, pavilions, basketball/racquetball/pickleball courts, disc golf, trails, fitness equipment; open sunrise to sunset. Primary community amenity; no centralized clubhouse or pool exists in the community per this source (verified absence).
Horse trails within the community; equestrian-friendly living with access to nearby Riverbend Park trails.
Bike trails; nearby Riverbend Park for nature/outdoor recreation.
Gated entrance with entrance and intersection maintenance and security cameras, supported by the voluntary Landowners Association (no enforcement authority; county zoning/building codes apply).

Annual events sponsored by the Landowners Association: Fourth of July parade and picnic, Trunk or Treat Halloween fundraiser, Holiday in the Park, Christmas home decorations tour; bi-monthly landowner meetings; newsletter 'Countryside Living'.
